title: Block 2: Build the 'Surgical Omniscience' CLI UI Renderer to enforce
description: Build the 'Surgical Omniscience' CLI UI Renderer to enforce the strict typographic, spatial, and color philosophies. [Acceptance Criteria: Module exposes rendering functions that output MACRO nodes in bold/caps, MESO nodes in title case, MICRO nodes in Pure White with a stepped `[ ... ]` spinner, strips conversational logs, and enforces a double-newline (60% negative space) on all tier transitions.]
